description: This file defines an Android Activity named SpeechActivity which performs real-time speech recognition using a TensorFlow model. It includes methods for initializing the user interface, loading labels and model files, recording audio data from the microphone, processing the audio with the model, and updating the UI based on recognition results.

classes.name: SpeechActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that captures audio input, performs speech recognition with TensorFlow, and updates the UI with recognized commands.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads labels and the TensorFlow model, sets up UI elements, and starts audio recording and recognition threads.

methods.name: requestMicrophonePermission
methods.description: Requests permission to record audio if running on Android M or higher.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles permission request result and starts recording and recognition upon grant.

methods.name: startRecording
methods.description: Starts a background thread to capture audio from the microphone.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Captures audio data into a buffer in a loop until stopped.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Starts a background thread to process audio data with the TensorFlow model.

methods.name: recognize
methods.description: Performs continuous audio processing: retrieves audio data, runs inference with TensorFlow, and updates UI based on recognition results.
